channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Martin County and St. Lucie County report 3 cyclospora cases as produce outbreak spreads
item.description: Two cases of cyclospora have been confirmed in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County since May as contaminated produce outbreaks tied to lettuce spread across the country.

item.title: Waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires hit Treasure Coast in Friday's severe weather

item.title: JetBlue canceling Vero Beach to New York JFK route in September
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Treasure Coast residents report confirmed cyclospora cases in St. Lucie and Martin counties
item.description: Five confirmed local cases of cyclospora have been reported since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County, as residents adjust diets to avoid contaminated produce.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent AI-assisted decisions
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 run in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's 27-year-old world record of 3:43.13.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey
item.description: Thousands of law enforcement personnel will be on the ground for Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain, with enhanced security including a Secret Service perimeter.

item.title: Photographer captures twist of fate: Messi bathed Yamal as baby before World Cup final matchup
item.description: Photos taken in 2007 show teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal for a charity calendar, nearly two decades before the two will face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal with late comeback goals
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with two goals in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 and advance to the World Cup final against Spain.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program connects families with summer service projects across South Florida
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation is offering hands-on volunteer opportunities for families this summer through the TLC Program, which stands for Tzedakah, Learning and Chesed.

item.title: South Florida residents change diets as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks spread
item.description: Residents across South Florida are eliminating lettuce and leafy greens from their diets as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks linked to contaminated produce continue to spread nationwide.
